sections.heading: Introduction
sections.body: AME Marketing is an integrated marketing communications company partnering with Vietnamese and international businesses to build brands and grow sustainably. We operate as a strategic marketing partner - connecting strategy, creative, technology and operations.

sections.heading: Core capabilities
sections.body: Eight service areas working together as one team:

sections.heading: Scale & markets
sections.body: Over 12 years of experience, 80+ projects delivered, with offices in Hanoi, Da Nang and Tokyo. Serving clients across four core APAC markets: Vietnam, Japan, Korea and Southeast Asia.

sections.heading: Client portfolio
sections.body: Growth-stage businesses with 50 to 5,000 employees across real estate, education, aesthetics, F&B, retail, technology, hospitality and professional services.

faq.title: Frequently asked
faq.sub: If you don't find the answer here, message AME - we respond within one business day.

items.q: Who is AME a good fit for?
items.a: We work best with businesses that need to rebuild their brand foundation, grow across channels or expand into new markets. Most of our clients have 50 to 5,000 employees.

items.q: How does a project usually start?
items.a: Step 1 - a 30-minute call to understand your needs. Step 2 - a free audit and direction. Step 3 - a quote and scope of work. Step 4 - kick off with a clear plan.

items.q: How long does a typical engagement take?
items.a: Branding 8 - 12 weeks, websites 6 - 10 weeks, performance launches in 2 - 3 weeks and is optimised continuously, IMC campaigns 6 - 16 weeks depending on scale.
Yes. We have a Japan desk in Tokyo and partner networks in Korea and Southeast Asia. We support localisation across Vietnamese, English, Japanese and Chinese.

items.q: Does AME offer standalone strategy advisory?
items.a: Yes. We offer a strategy retainer for companies with in-house teams that need an external strategic partner.
Every project has its own scope. After the free audit we send a transparent quote broken down by line item - no hidden costs.

sections.heading: 1. Information we collect
sections.body: AME Marketing collects information you voluntarily provide via contact forms, newsletter sign-up or email - including name, email, phone, company and a description of your needs. We also record basic technical data such as IP, browser type and browsing behaviour through cookies and analytics tools.

sections.heading: 2. Purpose of use
sections.body: Data is used to respond to consultation requests, deliver content you have subscribed to, improve the website experience and measure communications. We do not sell personal data to third parties.

sections.heading: 3. Storage and security
sections.body: Data is stored on infrastructure with security commitments and is accessible only to authorised team members. We apply reasonable technical and procedural measures to protect your information.

sections.heading: 4. Your rights
sections.body: You have the right to request access, correction or deletion of your personal data, and to withdraw consent for newsletters at any time. Contact amemartech@gmail.com to do so.

sections.heading: 5. Cookies
sections.body: The website uses essential and analytics cookies. You can disable cookies in your browser - some features may then be limited.

sections.heading: 6. Contact
sections.body: Any questions about this policy can be sent to amemartech@gmail.com.
